description: A single action offered by an action surface — the F5 TmMobileActionBar, the F4 overflow toolbar, and any future action host. The model is deliberately free of rendering concerns: a host maps an item to a button, a menu entry, or another surface.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Stable identity of the action (used as a render key). When empty, Label identifies the item. Must not start with 'tm-' when it lands in a CSS class or id — that prefix is reserved for library-internal stems.

properties.name: Label
properties.description: The user-visible label. Names the rendered button (and its full-text title).

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: Optional icon name (an IconNames value or a registered icon).

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Ordering hint: higher priority actions render earlier (farther left in LTR). Items with equal priority keep the order of Items; overflow into the "More" menu keeps this order.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.description: Disables the action. Disabled items render as disabled buttons/menuitems.

properties.name: OnClick
properties.description: The action itself. Invoked exactly once per user activation.
